responsibility: Provides the detailed scheduler model for the AppliedMicro X-Gene 1 core. It defines decoder, integer, divide, load/store, SIMD/FP, and compare resources plus extensive reservations for scalar Arm, VFP, NEON, and crypto-related instruction classes, enabling tuning and instruction scheduling to reflect the decode width, execution units, and latency characteristics of the xgene1 microarchitecture.
